public_body: Middleborough Gas And Electric Board Of Commissioners
overall: The AG found violations for improper executive session topics, inadequate purpose statements, non-union contract votes taken outside open session (without roll call), and late minute review; declined pre-July 2010 and non-OML claims.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged improper employee evaluations and non-union contract approvals in executive session at meetings before July 1, 2010.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we will not review alleged violations that o ccurred prior to July 1, 2010, ev en though they m ay have been discovered only recently.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Board discussed topics in executive session that did not fit any statutory purpose, including a billing error, investment, bonus policy and a GM performance review.
Complaints alleged the Board failed to state adequate executive session purposes; minutes cited 'strategic initiatives and other legal issues' and failed to identify the union.
Complaint alleged the Board voted in executive session on a non-union GM raise and compensation without a vote in open session.
allegations.key_passage: Bec ause the Board failed to take these votes in open s ession , it violated th e O pen Meetin g Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board's 4-1 raise vote for the non-union GM was not taken by roll call.
Complaint alleged the Board failed to release executive session minutes from 2009-2011 after the non-disclosure purposes had expired.
allegations.key_passage: The Board therefore violate d the Open Meeting Law by waiting until March 201 2 to review and pub licly release minutes that no lo nger required confidentiality.

allegations.summary: Complaint raised a 2009 employment agreement and salary action for the GM, which predated the AG's jurisdiction.
allegations.key_passage: However, we take no pos ition as to whether General Manager Grana han had a valid and binding employment agreem ent, as it appears the action with respect to his employment status occurred in 2 009, prior to our jurisdiction over the Open Me etin g Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint raised department management and failure to formally appoint the GM, which the AG said do not involve the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Bec ause th ese allega tion s d o not involve th e O pen Me eting Law, we dec lin e to r eview the m.

allegations.summary: Complaint concerned a February 2012 public records request, which the AG said is governed by the Public Records Law.
allegations.key_passage: Becau se this r equ est is g ove rned by t he Pub lic Recor ds L aw and not t he Op en Me etin g L aw , we d ecl ine to inv estigate t his allega tio n

allegations.summary: The Board asked the AG to review all 2003-2011 open and executive minutes and void actions; the AG declined a broad review.
allegations.key_passage: Our office declined to c onduct s uch a broad review of the Boa rd's minutes, noting it is our practice to investigate only spe cific allegations.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Entire Board to attend Open Meeting Law training (live or the AG's online video) and certify to the AG within sixty days.
